title: The Burning Bush Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Burning Bush Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Burning Bush Bible crossword: Horeb, the bush that was not consumed, holy ground and I AM THAT I AM. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Moses is keeping his father in law's flock on the backside of the desert when he sees a bush on fire that does not burn up. He turns aside to look, and a voice tells him to take off his shoes. The Burning Bush puts Exodus 3 into a grid — the mountain of God, the holy ground, the rod, and the name given when Moses asks what he should say.
It's an easy puzzle with one of the weightiest answers in the whole archive at its centre. The verse it closes on is the moment the bush first appears.

clues.text: It burned with fire and was not consumed
The mountain of God where it stood
He turned aside to see the great sight
Put off from his feet, for the ground was holy

verseText: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
